na + uktam fused with anyamālāvidhau in locative singular masculine
past participle of man, used as noun for doctrine or opinion

items.question: Which garland procedure accepts this doctrine as its view?
premises: this is not said in the garland
the other garland-vidhi holds it as view
items.inference: the doctrine belongs to the other garland-vidhi, not the garland itself
uncertainties: exact scope of mālikā versus anyamālāvidhi is not specified
items.plain_english: This is not said in the garland; in the other garland-vidhi it is the view.
